listing.description_text:
Na prodaju rustična vila u Paštrovskom stilu, 2,5 km od Petrovca (Kruševica), u mirnom i izolovanom dijelu. Plac površine 578 m² je popločan kamenom i ima poseban prilaz, garaže za 5 vozila, fitnes salu i bazen od 31 m².
Vila ima ukupno 466 m² stambenog prostora. U prizemlju se nalaze dnevni boravak, kuhinja sa izlazom na dvije terase, dvije spavaće sobe, kupatilo i gostinski toalet. Na spratu su dva fizički odvojena dvosobna stana sa sopstvenim kupatilima i terasama.
Ukupno: 6 spavaćih soba, 5 kupatila, 3 kuhinje, 4 terase. Gradnja započeta 2009, završena 2013. Uknjiženo 1/1, upotrebna dozvola izdata.
067/231-153
listing.description_text_en:
For sale, a rustic villa in Paštrovići style, 2.5 km from Petrovac (Kruševica), in a quiet and isolated part. The land plot with an area of 578 m² is paved with stone and has separate access, garages for 5 vehicles, a fitness room, and a pool of 31 m².
The villa has a total of 466 m² of living space. On the ground floor there are a living room, a kitchen with access to two terraces, two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a guest toilet. On the first floor are two physically separated two-bedroom apartments with their own bathrooms and terraces.
Total: 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 3 kitchens, 4 terraces. Construction started 2009, completed 2013. Registered 1/1, occupancy permit issued.
067/231-153

listing.description_text:
U Krašićima, opština Tivat, na prvoj liniji do mora, nalazi se plac od 506 m² sa dozvolom za izgradnju vile površine 350 m². Već je izgrađen prvi sprat, a prema projektu planiran je mini-hotel sa šest apartmana, uz mogućnost prilagođavanja u porodičnu kuću.
Imanje raspolaže i privatnim betonskim pristaništem od 160 m². Projekat je odobren, komunalije su plaćene, izvedeni su iskopi, podrum i potporni zidovi. Struja, voda i kanalizacija su dovedeni do placa. Lokacija je mirna, sa restoranima i prodavnicama na pješačkoj udaljenosti.
listing.description_text_en:
In Krašići, municipality of Tivat, on the first line to the sea, there is a land plot of 506 m² with a permit for the construction of a villa of 350 m². The first floor has already been built, and according to the project, a mini-hotel with six apartments is planned, with the possibility of adapting it into a family house.
The property also has a private concrete pier of 160 m². The project is approved, utilities are paid, excavations, a basement and retaining walls have been carried out. Electricity, water and sewerage have been brought to the land plot. The location is quiet, with restaurants and shops within walking distance.

listing.title_text: Prodaja, trosoban stan, 246m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.title_text_en: Sale, three bedroom apartment, 246m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description_text:
Prodaje se trosoban stan povrsine 246.27m2 sa pogledom na more i grad koji je lociran na 8. spratu kompleksa u izgradnji na prvoj liniji mora u Budvi.
Rok završetka: april 2028.
Raspored plaćanja:Rezervacija: 10.000 € (nepovratno)30% kupoprodajne cene – u roku od 10 dana od potpisivanja Preliminarnog ugovoraPreostali iznos kupci plaćaju u tri rate:Prva rata 30% – nakon završetka konstrukcijeDruga rata 30% – nakon završetka završnih radovaTreća rata 10% – prilikom primopredaje nekretnineOvaj jedinstveni kompleks nalazi se u samom epicentru turističke Budve, na šetalištu, okružen fantastičnim prirodnim uslovima i panoramskim pogledom koji spaja najbolje od Budvanske rivijere sa modernim objektima, sadržajima i uslugama hotela sa 5 zvezdica.
Stambene jedinice dostupne za prodaju nalaze se od četvrtog do devetog sprata. Ovi pažljivo dizajnirani stanovi pružaju savršen spoj luksuza i funkcionalnosti, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na okolinu. Deseti sprat je isključivo posvećen penthaus apartmanima, koji se mogu pohvaliti raskošnim sadržajima kao što su hidromasažne kade i prostrane terase. Ukupno je dostupno 66 apartmana za kupovinu, uključujući sobe, apartmane i penthaus apartmane.
Kompleks poseduje dva ulaza – jedan pogodno lociran na šetalištu, a drugi pristupačan sa bulevara. Glavni ulaz, smešten u aneksu kongresnog centra, omogućava lak pristup raznim događajima i konferencijama.
Sadržaji kompleksa:Poslovni prostor, prodavnice i servisni centarDva restorana i kafić sa pogledom na Jadransko moreSpa centar sa bazenima i teretanomKonferencijski sadržajiPodzemni objekti: tehničke prostorije i podzemni parking sa ukupno 160 parking mestaUsluge i sigurnost:Konsijerž i 24-časovno obezbeđenje garantuju mir i sigurnostRaznovrsna ponuda hotela sa pet zvezdica i sadržaja Budve pretvara vašu investiciju u luksuzni stil životaZelena oaza:Ovaj savremeni objekat takođe nudi zelenu oazu na krovu konferencijske sale, gde ćete moći da uživate u prirodi. Poseban fokus je stavljen na održavanje zelenih površina, koje omogućavaju vlasnicima i gostima sezonsko uživanje u prirodi i lokalnoj flori na kućnom pragu.
Pogodnosti:Dva hotelska restorana, kafić, kancelarije i prodavnice na prvim spratovimaSpa centar sa teretanom i bazenimaZelena oaza na krovuBrendirane rezidencijeTehničke prostorije i podzemni parkingBrendirane rezidencije sa uslugom održavanjaPaketi nameštaja dostupni za useljenje

listing.title_text: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 87m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 87m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description_text:
Prodaje se jednosoban stan povrsine 87.21m2 sa pogledom na more koji je lociran na 8. spratu kompleksa u izgradnji na prvoj liniji mora u Budvi.
Rok završetka: april 2028.
Raspored plaćanja:Rezervacija: 10.000 € (nepovratno)30% kupoprodajne cene – u roku od 10 dana od potpisivanja Preliminarnog ugovoraPreostali iznos kupci plaćaju u tri rate:Prva rata 30% – nakon završetka konstrukcijeDruga rata 30% – nakon završetka završnih radovaTreća rata 10% – prilikom primopredaje nekretnineOvaj jedinstveni kompleks nalazi se u samom epicentru turističke Budve, na šetalištu, okružen fantastičnim prirodnim uslovima i panoramskim pogledom koji spaja najbolje od Budvanske rivijere sa modernim objektima, sadržajima i uslugama hotela sa 5 zvezdica.
Stambene jedinice dostupne za prodaju nalaze se od četvrtog do devetog sprata. Ovi pažljivo dizajnirani stanovi pružaju savršen spoj luksuza i funkcionalnosti, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na okolinu. Deseti sprat je isključivo posvećen penthaus apartmanima, koji se mogu pohvaliti raskošnim sadržajima kao što su hidromasažne kade i prostrane terase. Ukupno je dostupno 66 apartmana za kupovinu, uključujući sobe, apartmane i penthaus apartmane.
Kompleks poseduje dva ulaza – jedan pogodno lociran na šetalištu, a drugi pristupačan sa bulevara. Glavni ulaz, smešten u aneksu kongresnog centra, omogućava lak pristup raznim događajima i konferencijama.
Sadržaji kompleksa:Poslovni prostor, prodavnice i servisni centarDva restorana i kafić sa pogledom na Jadransko moreSpa centar sa bazenima i teretanomKonferencijski sadržajiPodzemni objekti: tehničke prostorije i podzemni parking sa ukupno 160 parking mestaUsluge i sigurnost:Konsijerž i 24-časovno obezbeđenje garantuju mir i sigurnostRaznovrsna ponuda hotela sa pet zvezdica i sadržaja Budve pretvara vašu investiciju u luksuzni stil životaZelena oaza:Ovaj savremeni objekat takođe nudi zelenu oazu na krovu konferencijske sale, gde ćete moći da uživate u prirodi. Poseban fokus je stavljen na održavanje zelenih površina, koje omogućavaju vlasnicima i gostima sezonsko uživanje u prirodi i lokalnoj flori na kućnom pragu.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, hospitality venue, 20995m², Luštica, Herceg Novi
listing.description_text:
Prodaja zemljišta sa projektom hotela sa 5 zvezdica.
Zemljište se nalazi na crnogorskom poluostrvu Luštica, u najvećem zalivu na Jadranskom moru - na obali Boko Kotorskog zaliva, koji se naziva najjužnijim fjordom u Evropi, 10 minuta od tivatskog aerodroma.
Poslednji plac na samoj obali mora gde je još uvek moguće izgraditi hotel sa 5 zvezdica. Priroda ovde je luksuzna. Veličanstvene planine, azurno more. Usamljene uvale sa sitnim peščanim i šljunčanim plažama su raštrkane duž obale, a u okolini se nalaze borovi i maslinjaci, autentična sela, privatna imanja i vinogradi. Jednom rečju, idila.
Postavljeni su temelji za izgradnju područja Golf Residences. Svetski poznati igrač Geri Plejer je pozvan da razvije projekat golf terena. Ovde će biti izgrađen profesionalni teren sa 18 rupa, prvih 9 će biti otvoreno do kraja 2023. godine. Generalno, projekat je jedinstveni. Prema rečima stručnjaka, manje od 10% golf terena u svetu pruža mogućnost posmatranja mora sa bilo koje tačke.
Naselje Centrale će postati trgovački, administrativni i kulturni centar.
Tu će biti smeštene glavne gradske službe: obdanište, škola i zdravstveni centar, policijska i vatrogasna stanica, banka, pošta, autoservis i benzinska pumpa, autlet selo, konferencijski centar i sportski kompleksi. U naselju će biti uređeni novi parkovi, uređena šetališta, otvorene galerije, prodavnice i kafići na centralnom trgu.
Cena zemljišta je 9 447 750 e
Površina placa 20 995 m2
Ukupna površina kompleksa - 16 287 m2
HOTEL:
Ukupna površina nadzemnih etaža 8 382,34 m2 Ukupna površina podzemnih etaža 5.956,10 m2 Ukupna površina hotela 14.338,44 m2
KUĆA ZA GOSTE:
Ukupna površina nadzemnih 1.620,60 m2 Ukupna površina podzemnih etaža 328,23 m2 Ukupna površina hotela 1 948, 83 m2
listing.description_text_en:
Sale of a land plot with a 5-star hotel project.
The land plot is located on the Montenegrin peninsula Luštica, in the largest bay on the Adriatic Sea - on the coast of Boko Kotorskog zaliva, which is called the southernmost fjord in Europe, 10 minutes from Tivat airport.
The last land plot directly on the seashore where it is still possible to build a 5-star hotel. The nature here is luxurious. Magnificent mountains, azure sea. Secluded coves with fine sandy and pebble beaches are scattered along the coast, and in the surroundings there are pine and olive groves, authentic villages, private estates and vineyards. In a word, an idyll.
Foundations have been laid for the construction of the Golf Residences area. World-renowned player Geri Plejer has been invited to develop the golf course project. Here, an 18-hole professional course will be built, the first 9 will be open by the end of 2023. Generally, the project is unique. According to experts, less than 10% of golf courses in the world offer the possibility of observing the sea from any point.
The Centrale settlement will become a commercial, administrative, and cultural center.
The main city services will be located there: kindergarten, school, and health center, police and fire station, bank, post office, car service, and gas station, outlet village, conference center, and sports complexes. New parks will be arranged in the settlement, arranged promenades, open galleries, shops, and cafes on the central square.
The price of the land plot is 9 447 750 e
Area of the land plot 20 995 m2
Total area of the complex - 16 287 m2

listing.title_text: Prodaja, trosoban stan, 282m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.title_text_en: Sale, three bedroom apartment, 282m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description_text:
Nekretnine, Crna GoraNa prodaju je luksuzan trosoban penthouse stan sa spektakularnim direktnim pogledom na more, smešten u prestižnom kompleksu Dukley Gardens, Budva.
Stan ima površinu od 282m², uz dodatak krovne terase od 235m², idealne za uživanje u panoramskim pogledima i opuštanje na otvorenom.
Ova nekretnina je kompletno završena i useljiva, pružajući vam mogućnost da se odmah uselite i uživate u svim pogodnostima koje nudi.
Postoji mogućnost kupovine ove nekretnine u kriptovaluti Bitcoin, čime se omogućava fleksibilnost u plaćanju.
Dukley Gardens je elitna nekretnina na jadranskoj obali u najslikovitijem mestu Crne Gore. Otkrijte Crnu Goru, zemlju ogromnih prirodnih bogatstava i najčistijeg mora, prirodnih ukusa i pažljivo očuvanih drevnih tradicija. Svaki dan, svaki minut će biti ispunjen harmonijom i lepotom. Od sjajnog izlaska sunca do romantičnog zalaska sunca, čekaju vas nezaboravni utisci koje ćete želeti da iskusite iznova i iznova. Dopustite sebi da se opustite u prostranom i udobnom domu, opustite se na plaži skrivenoj od radoznalih očiju, uživajte u gastronomskoj večeri na ogromnoj terasi sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadran.
Osmišljen od strane međunarodne grupe uglednih projektanata, renomiranih graditelja i nagrađivanih arhitekata, u saradnji sa vrhunskim kreativnim timom konsultanata za dizajn i tehnologiju, Dukley nudi izvanredne sadržaje i usluge. Sa pogledom na jednu od najlepših obala na svetu, ovaj kompleks ekskluzivnih rezidencijalnih vila spaja najmoderniju infrastrukturu, sofisticirani savremeni dizajn i vrhunske sadržaje, podižući ljestvicu kvaliteta primorskih rezidencijalnih kompleksa u Crnoj Gori.
Uz pomoć najsavremenije Smart Home tehnologije koja osigurava kompletnu bezbednost, stanari kompleksa Dukley Gardens mogu kontrolisati svoje stanove koristeći lične uređaje. Putem telefona ili tableta svaki stanar može upravljati osvetljenjem i klima uređajima, kao i multimedija sistemima i sistemima za bezbednost i nadzor u svom stanu.

listing.description_text_en:
Real Estate, MontenegroFor sale is a luxurious three-bedroom penthouse apartment with a spectacular direct sea view, located in the prestigious Dukley Gardens complex, Budva.
The apartment has an area of 2282m², along with a 235m² rooftop terrace, perfect for enjoying panoramic views and relaxing outdoors.
This property is fully finished and ready to move in, offering you the opportunity to settle in immediately and enjoy all the amenities it offers.
There is an option to purchase this property using the cryptocurrency Bitcoin, providing flexibility in payment.
Dukley Gardens is an elite property on the Adriatic coast in the most picturesque place in Montenegro. Discover Montenegro, a land of vast natural wealth and the cleanest sea, natural flavors, and carefully preserved ancient traditions. Every day, every moment will be filled with harmony and beauty. From the brilliant sunrise to the romantic sunset, unforgettable impressions await you that you will want to experience again and again. Allow yourself to relax in a spacious and comfortable home, unwind on a beach hidden from prying eyes, and enjoy a gourmet dinner on a large terrace with a panoramic view of the Adriatic.
Designed by an international group of renowned designers, builders, and award-winning architects, in collaboration with a top creative team of design and technology consultants, Dukley offers exceptional amenities and services. With a view of one of the most beautiful coastlines in the world, this complex of exclusive residential villas combines the most modern infrastructure, sophisticated contemporary design, and premium amenities, raising the bar for the quality of coastal residential complexes in Montenegro.
With the help of the most advanced Smart Home technology ensuring complete security, Dukley Gardens residents can control their apartments using personal devices. Via phone or tablet, each resident can manage lighting and climate control, as well as multimedia systems and security and surveillance systems in their apartment.

listing.description_text:
Smještena u mirnoj i prestižnoj rezidencijalnoj zoni Gornje Gorice, predstavlja spoj moderne arhitekture, vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i sofisticiranog načina života. Ova ekskluzivna vila površine 231 m² projektovana je sa posebnim fokusom na funkcionalnost, privatnost i dugoročnu vrijednost nekretnine.
Prostran i svijetao enterijer karakterišu otvoreni koncept dnevnog boravka, velike staklene površine i obilje prirodnog svjetla tokom cijelog dana, stvarajući prijatan i elegantan ambijent za svakodnevni život.
Vila posjeduje privatnu wellness zonu koja uključuje grijani bazen sa masažnim mlazovima i luksuznu finsku KYRA saunu, pružajući potpuni osjećaj relaksacije i odmora u udobnosti sopstvenog doma.
Objekat je opremljen naprednim Smart Home sistemom koji omogućava jednostavno upravljanje rasvjetom, grijanjem, hlađenjem, sigurnosnim sistemima i ostalim funkcijama putem mobilnog telefona. Dodatni nivo sigurnosti obezbijeđen je HD video nadzorom, alarmnim sistemom, kontrolom pristupa i perimetarskom zaštitom.
Energetska efikasnost vile postignuta je savremenim sistemima kao što su podno grijanje sa toplotnom pumpom, multi-split i kanalni klima sistemi bez vidljivih unutrašnjih jedinica, kao i unaprijed pripremljena infrastruktura za solarne panele, što omogućava niže troškove energije i održiv način života.
U izgradnji i opremanju korišćeni su premium materijali i renomirani svjetski brendovi poput Porcelanosa keramike, Tarkett parketa, Hansgrohe AXOR i Geberit sanitarnih sistema, Villeroy & Boch opreme, Florim keramike i aluminijumske stolarije, garantujući vrhunsku estetiku, dugotrajnost i visoku tržišnu vrijednost nekretnine.
Lokacija vile pruža idealan balans između privatnosti i urbanog života.
listing.description_text_en:
Located in the quiet and prestigious residential zone of Gornja Gorica, it represents a blend of modern architecture, premium construction quality, and a sophisticated lifestyle. This exclusive villa with an area of 231 m² is designed with a special focus on functionality, privacy, and long-term property value.
The spacious and bright interior is characterized by an open-concept living room, large glass surfaces, and an abundance of natural light throughout the day, creating a pleasant and elegant ambiance for everyday life.
The villa has a private wellness zone which includes a heated pool with massage jets and a luxurious Finnish KYRA sauna, providing a complete sense of relaxation and rest in the comfort of your own home.
The property is equipped with an advanced Smart Home system which allows for easy control of lighting, heating, cooling, security systems, and other functions via mobile phone. An additional level of security is provided by HD video surveillance, an alarm system, access control, and perimeter protection.
The energy efficiency of the villa is achieved through modern systems such as underfloor heating with a heat pump, multi-split and ducted air conditioning systems without visible indoor units, as well as pre-prepared infrastructure for solar panels, which enables lower energy costs and a sustainable lifestyle.
Premium materials and renowned global brands were used in the construction and furnishing such as Porcelanosa ceramics, Tarkett parquet, Hansgrohe AXOR and Geberit sanitary systems, Villeroy & Boch equipment, Florim ceramics, and aluminum joinery, guaranteeing superior aesthetics, durability, and high market value of the property.
The villa's location provides an ideal balance between privacy and urban life.

listing.description_text:
IZDAVANJE | Luksuzna vila – Gorica C, Podgorica
Izdaje se ekskluzivna luksuzna vila površine 400m², smještena u jednom od najprestižnijih i najtraženijih djelova Podgorice – Gorica C.
Vila se nalazi u mirnom, zelenom i elitnom okruženju, u neposrednoj blizini ambasada i rezidencijalnih objekata, što je čini idealnim izborom za ambasade, predstavništva, kompanije, rezidencijalnu namjenu ili luksuzan porodični život.
Nekretnina se prostire na placu površine 600m² i sastoji se od dva odvojena stambena dijela, pružajući visok nivo funkcionalnosti, privatnosti i fleksibilnosti u organizaciji prostora.
Donji nivo ima poseban ulaz i funkcioniše kao nezavisna stambena jedinica. Sastoji se od dvije prostorije, kupatila, vešeraja i direktnog izlaza u dvorište.
Gornji nivoi obuhvataju četiri prostrane spavaće sobe, veliki salon, dnevni boravak, trpezariju, kuhinju, galeriju iznad dnevnog boravka koja može služiti kao biblioteka, radni prostor ili kancelarija, dva kupatila i gostinjski toalet.
Vila raspolaže sa četiri terase, lijepo uređenim dvorištem, garažom i dodatnim parkingom za dva vozila ispred kuće. Grijanje i hlađenje obezbijeđeni su putem split sistema.
Osnovne informacije:
• Lokacija: Gorica C, Podgorica
• Površina kuće: 400m²
• Površina placa: 600m²
• Broj soba: 5+
• Broj kupatila: 3

listing.description_text_en:
FOR LEASE | Luxurious villa – Gorica C, Podgorica
An exclusive luxurious villa with an area of 400m² is for lease, located in one of the most prestigious and most sought-after parts of Podgorica – Gorica C.
The villa is located in a peaceful, green, and elite environment, in the immediate vicinity of embassies and residential buildings, which makes it an ideal choice for embassies, representative offices, companies, residential purposes, or a luxurious family life.
The property is spread on a land plot with an area of 600m² and consists of two separate residential units, providing a high level of functionality, privacy, and flexibility in space organization.
The lower level has a separate entrance and functions as an independent residential unit. It consists of two rooms, a bathroom, a laundry room, and a direct exit to the courtyard.
The upper levels comprise four spacious bedrooms, a large lounge, a living room, a dining room, a kitchen, a gallery above the living room which can serve as a library, workspace, or office, two bathrooms, and a guest toilet.
The villa features four terraces, a beautifully landscaped courtyard, a garage, and additional parking for two vehicles in front of the house. Heating and cooling are provided via a split system.
Basic information:
• Location: Gorica C, Podgorica
• House area: 400m²
• Land plot area: 600m²
• Number of rooms: 5+
• Number of bathrooms: 3
• Garage + additional parking for 2 vehicles

listing.title_text: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 49m², Portonovi, Herceg Novi
listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 49m², Portonovi, Herceg Novi
listing.description_text:
Rezidencijalni kompleks sa pogledom na Bokokotorski zaliv
Smješten u Herceg Novom, u neposrednoj blizini prestižnog Portonovi rizorta i svega oko 200 metara od mora, ovaj savremeni rezidencijalni kompleks predstavlja atraktivnu priliku za život, odmor i investiranje.
Kompleks obuhvata 56 stambenih jedinica, sa jednosobnim (1+1) i dvosobnim (2+1) stanovima. Zahvaljujući atraktivnoj lokaciji i okolnoj izgradnji, stanovi nude otvoren pogled prema moru i Bokokotorskom zalivu.
Stanovi 1+1: 48,56 – 58,79 m² Cijena: 350.000 – 430.100 € Cijena zavisi od spratnosti i pozicije.
Sadržaji kompleksa
Stanovnicima i gostima na raspolaganju su brojni sadržaji:
• otvoreni i zatvoreni bazen
• moderna teretana
• tursko kupatilo i sauna
• prostor za odmor i kafić
• dječije igralište
• recepcija i obezbjeđenje
• otvoreni parking i podzemna garaža
• lift za automobile
• stanica za punjenje električnih vozila
• rezervni generator za kontinuirano snabdijevanje električnom energijom
Investiciona vrijednost
Kompleks je pogodan za kratkoročno i dugoročno izdavanje, kao i za privatno korišćenje. Kupcima koji nekretninu kupuju kao investiciju biće pružena podrška u procesu izdavanja i upravljanja rentiranjem.
Lokacija u neposrednoj blizini Portonovi rizorta, luksuznih vila, marine i hotela dodatno povećava atraktivnost nekretnine. Hotel One&Only nalazi se na približno 150 metara, dok je plaža udaljena oko 400 metara. U okolini se nalaze restorani, prodavnice, škole, parkovi i drugi sadržaji.
Finansiranje i plan plaćanja
Predviđen je fleksibilan model kupovine:
• 50% početnog učešća
• 50% kroz mjesečne ili kvartalne rate do 24 mjeseca
• dinamika plaćanja se može uskladiti sa individualnim dogovorom i fazom izgradnje
Dostupna je i mogućnost kreditnog finansiranja do 30% vrijednosti nekretnine putem partnerskih banaka Erste i Ziraat, uz planirano proširenje saradnje sa Adriatic bankom.
Šta je uključeno u cijenu
U cijenu stana uključeni su PDV i kuhinjski namještaj. Kuhinjski aparati nijesu uključeni.
Troškovi prenosa vlasništva, notarske i druge administrativne takse nijesu uključeni.
Parking se prodaje posebno:
• Otvoreno parking mjesto: 10.000 €
• Podzemno garažno mjesto: 30.000 €
Ova nekretnina predstavlja spoj luksuzne lokacije, savremenih sadržaja, pogleda na more i investicionog potencijala, pogodnog kako za vlastito korišćenje, tako i za prihod od izdavanja.
listing.description_text_en:
Residential complex with a view of Bokokotorski zaliv
Located in Herceg Novom, in the immediate vicinity of the prestigious Portonovi resort and only about 200 meters from the sea, this modern residential complex represents an attractive opportunity for living, vacation, and investment.
The complex includes 56 residential units, with one-bedroom (1+1) and two-bedroom (2+1) apartments. Thanks to the attractive location and surrounding construction, the apartments offer an open view towards the sea and Bokokotorski zaliv.
Apartments 1+1: 48,56 – 58,79 m² Price: 350.000 – 430.100 € The price depends on the floor and position.
Complex amenities
Numerous amenities are available to residents and guests:
• outdoor and indoor pool
• modern gym
• Turkish bath and sauna
• relaxation area and cafe
• children's playground
• reception and security
• outdoor parking and underground garage
• car elevator
• electric vehicle charging station
• backup generator for continuous electricity supply
Investment value
The complex is suitable for short-term and long-term rental, as well as for private use. Buyers who purchase the property as an investment will be provided with support in the process of renting out and rental management.
The location in the immediate vicinity of Portonovi resort, luxury villas, marina, and hotels further increases the attractiveness of the property. Hotel One&Only is located approximately 150 meters away, while the beach is about 400 meters away. In the surroundings, there are restaurants, shops, schools, parks, and other amenities.
Financing and payment plan
A flexible purchase model is foreseen:
• 50% initial down payment
• 50% through monthly or quarterly installments up to 24 months
• payment dynamics can be aligned with individual agreement and the construction phase
The possibility of loan financing up to 30% of the property value through partner banks Erste and Ziraat, with a planned expansion of cooperation with Adriatic bank, is also available.
What is included in the price
The apartment price includes VAT and kitchen furniture. Kitchen appliances are not included.
Costs of ownership transfer, notary, and other administrative fees are not included.
Parking is sold separately:
• Outdoor parking space: 10.000 €
• Underground garage space: 30.000 €
This property represents a combination of luxury location, modern amenities, sea views, and investment potential, suitable for both private use and rental income.

listing.description_text:
EKSKLUZIVNI TOWNHOUSE PROJEKAT
Predstavljamo vam ekskluzivan kompleks od 9 luksuznih townhouse vila, projektovanih za savršen spoj modernog dizajna, komfora, privatnosti i prirodnog okruženja.
Smešten na jednoj od najatraktivnijih lokacija crnogorskog primorja, kompleks pruža panoramski pogled na Jadransko more, planine i Sveti Stefan. Mirna lokacija, visok standard gradnje i odlična povezanost sa najpoznatijim destinacijama čine ovaj projekat idealnim za luksuzno stanovanje, odmor ili investiciju sa potencijalom za profitabilno izdavanje.
ISTAKNUTA JEDINICA – TOWNHOUSE C-2 | 295 m²
Kompleks je organizovan u tri objekta – A, B i C – sa po tri townhouse jedinice, ukupno 9 ekskluzivnih vila. Svaka vila prostire se na četiri nivoa i pažljivo je osmišljena kako bi pružila maksimalnu funkcionalnost, privatnost i uživanje u panoramskom pogledu.
Glavne karakteristike vila:
• 4 prostrane spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima
• 2 dnevne zone
• 2 potpuno opremljene kuhinje
• privatni bazen
• prostrane terase sa pogledom na more
• garaža za 2 automobila
• visoki plafoni od 3 m
• panoramski prozori visine 2,5 m
• video nadzor i interfon
• multi-split klima sistem
• optički internet
• sistem zaštite od požara
• centralno zagrevanje vode
• rezervni tehnički sistemi
VRHUNSKI STANDARDI GRADNJE
Arhitektura vila kombinuje savremenu estetiku sa prirodnim i kvalitetnim materijalima. Eksterijer karakteriše prirodni kamen, dok energetski efikasna aluminijumska stolarija i velike staklene površine obezbeđuju obilje prirodnog svetla i neometan pogled prema moru.
Enterijer je opremljen pažljivo odabranim materijalima visokog kvaliteta, uključujući hrastov parket u spavaćim sobama, vrhunsku keramiku i sanitarije renomiranog brenda Villeroy & Boch. Svaka vila poseduje kompletan smart tehnički i sigurnosni sistem.
PRIVATNI BAZEN
Privatni bazen predstavlja idealno mesto za opuštanje i uživanje tokom toplih letnjih dana. Opremljen je kompletnim sistemom za filtraciju, osvetljenje i održavanje, pružajući vlasnicima visok nivo komfora i privatnosti.
ATRAKTIVNA LOKACIJA
Projekat se nalazi u mirnom i privatnom okruženju, a istovremeno je odlično povezan sa najvažnijim destinacijama crnogorskog primorja:
• 5 minuta do Svetog Stefana
• 10 minuta do Budve
• 30 minuta do Porto Montenegra i Kotora
• oko 50 minuta do aerodroma Tivat
• oko 50 minuta do aerodroma Podgorica
USLOVI PLAĆANJA
• 5.000 € – rezervacija
• 10% – pri potpisu ugovora
• 30% – nakon završetka grubih radova
• 30% – nakon završetka finih radova
• 30% – po dobijanju upotrebne dozvole, umanjeno za iznos rezervacije
Ovaj projekat predstavlja izuzetnu priliku za kupce koji žele luksuznu rezidenciju na crnogorskom primorju, ali i za investitore zainteresovane za visokoprofitabilno turističko izdavanje.
Townhouse C-2 | 295 m² – spoj savremenog luksuza, privatnosti i jedinstvenog pogleda na Jadran.
listing.description_text_en:
EXCLUSIVE TOWNHOUSE PROJECT
We present an exclusive complex of 9 luxury townhouse villas, designed for a perfect blend of modern design, comfort, privacy, and natural surroundings.
Located in one of the most attractive locations on the Montenegrin coast, the complex offers panoramic views of Jadransko more, mountains, and Sveti Stefan. A quiet location, high construction standards, and excellent connectivity to the most famous destinations make this project ideal for luxury living, vacation, or investment with potential for profitable rental.
FEATURED UNIT – TOWNHOUSE C-2 | 295 m²
The complex is organized into three buildings – A, B, and C – each with three townhouse units, totaling 9 exclusive villas. Each villa spans four levels and is carefully designed to provide maximum functionality, privacy, and enjoyment of the panoramic view.
Main characteristics of the villas:
• 4 spacious bedrooms with private bathrooms
• 2 living areas
• 2 fully equipped kitchens
• private pool
• spacious terraces with sea views
• garage for 2 cars
• high ceilings of 3 m
• panoramic windows 2.5 m high
• video surveillance and intercom
• multi-split air conditioning system
• fiber optic internet
• fire protection system
• central water heating
• backup technical systems
PREMIUM CONSTRUCTION STANDARDS
The architecture of the villas combines contemporary aesthetics with natural and quality materials. The exterior features natural stone, while energy-efficient aluminum joinery and large glass surfaces ensure abundant natural light and unobstructed sea views.
The interior is equipped with carefully selected high-quality materials, including oak parquet in the bedrooms, premium ceramics, and sanitary ware from the renowned brand Villeroy & Boch. Each villa features a complete smart technical and security system.
PRIVATE POOL
The private pool is an ideal place for relaxation and enjoyment during warm summer days. It is equipped with a complete system for filtration, lighting, and maintenance, providing owners with a high level of comfort and privacy.
ATTRACTIVE LOCATION
The project is located in a quiet and private environment, while also being well-connected to the most important destinations of the Montenegrin coast:
• 5 minutes to Sveti Stefan
• 10 minutes to Budva
• 30 minutes to Porto Montenegro and Kotor
• about 50 minutes to Tivat airport
• about 50 minutes to Podgorica airport
PAYMENT TERMS
• 5,000 € – reservation
• 10% – upon signing the contract
• 30% – after completion of rough works
• 30% – after completion of fine works
• 30% – upon obtaining the occupancy permit, reduced by the reservation amount
This project represents an exceptional opportunity for buyers seeking a luxury residence on the Montenegrin coast, as well as for investors interested in high-profit tourist rentals.
Townhouse C-2 | 295 m² – a blend of contemporary luxury, privacy, and unique views of the Adriatic.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 46m², Radanovići, Kotor
listing.description_text:
Moderan stambeni kompleks u Radanovićima – spoj komfora, prirode i odlične lokacije
Na atraktivnoj lokaciji u Radanovićima, između Tivta, Kotora i Budve, gradi se moderan stambeni kompleks koji pruža idealne uslove za stanovanje, odmor ili investiciju.
Kompleks obuhvata 5 stambenih lamela sa ukupno 72 stana, različitih struktura – garsonjere, jednosobne i dvosobne stanove. Pažljivo osmišljeni rasporedi, savremeni enterijeri, prostrane terase i funkcionalni prostori pružaju udobnost i kvalitet svakodnevnog života.
Sadržaji i pogodnosti:
• Grijani poluolimpijski bazen
• Uređene zelene površine i botanički vrt
• Dječje igralište i prostor za rekreaciju
• Savremena arhitektura i elegantan dizajn enterijera
• Kuhinja sa ugradnim elementima
• Klima uređaji i Smart Home sistem
• Otvoreni parking
• Garažno mjesto po cijeni od 10.000 €
Pojedini stanovi u prizemlju imaju pristup privatnim zelenim površinama, dok stanovi na višim spratovima nude prostrane terase.
Fleksibilni uslovi plaćanja:
• 40% učešća prilikom kupovine
• Preostalih 60% kroz 24 mjesečne rate bez kamate
• 5% popusta za jednokratno plaćanje cjelokupnog iznosa
Mirno okruženje, uređeno dvorište i blizina svih važnih sadržaja čine ovaj kompleks odličnim izborom za porodični život, odmor na primorju ili dugoročnu investiciju.
Planirani završetak radova: april 2027. godine.
listing.description_text_en:
Modern residential complex in Radanovići – a combination of comfort, nature, and an excellent location
In an attractive location in Radanovići, between Tivat, Kotor, and Budva, a modern residential complex is being built, providing ideal conditions for living, vacation, or investment.
The complex includes 5 residential buildings with a total of 72 apartments, of various structures – studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments. Carefully designed layouts, modern interiors, spacious terraces, and functional spaces provide comfort and quality for everyday living.
Amenities and advantages:
• Heated semi-Olympic pool
• Landscaped green areas and botanical garden
• Children's playground and recreation area
• Modern architecture and elegant interior design
• Kitchen with built-in elements
• Air conditioning units and Smart Home system
• Open parking
• Garage space at a price of 10.000 €
Some apartments on the ground floor have access to private green areas, while apartments on higher floors offer spacious terraces.
Flexible payment terms:
• 40% down payment upon purchase
• Remaining 60% in 24 monthly installments without interest
• 5% discount for one-time payment of the full amount
Peaceful surroundings, a landscaped courtyard, and proximity to all important amenities make this complex an excellent choice for family life, vacation on the coast, or a long-term investment.
Planned completion of works: April 2027.

Na atraktivnoj lokaciji u Radanovićima, između Tivta, Kotora i Budve, gradi se moderan stambeni kompleks koji pruža idealne uslove za stanovanje, odmor ili investiciju.
Kompleks obuhvata 5 stambenih lamela sa ukupno 72 stana, različitih struktura – garsonjere, jednosobne i dvosobne stanove. Pažljivo osmišljeni rasporedi, savremeni enterijeri, prostrane terase i funkcionalni prostori pružaju udobnost i kvalitet svakodnevnog života.
Sadržaji i pogodnosti:
• Grijani poluolimpijski bazen
• Uređene zelene površine i botanički vrt
• Dječje igralište i prostor za rekreaciju
• Savremena arhitektura i elegantan dizajn enterijera
• Kuhinja sa ugradnim elementima
• Klima uređaji i Smart Home sistem
• Otvoreni parking
• Garažno mjesto po cijeni od 10.000 €
Pojedini stanovi u prizemlju imaju pristup privatnim zelenim površinama, dok stanovi na višim spratovima nude prostrane terase.
Mirno okruženje, uređeno dvorište i blizina svih važnih sadržaja čine ovaj kompleks odličnim izborom za porodični život, odmor na primorju ili dugoročnu investiciju.
Planirani završetak radova: maj 2027. godine.
listing.description_text_en:
Modern residential complex in Radanovići – a blend of comfort, nature, and excellent location
In an attractive location in Radanovići, between Tivat, Kotor, and Budva, a modern residential complex is being built, providing ideal conditions for living, vacation, or investment.
The complex comprises 5 residential buildings with a total of 72 apartments of various structures – studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. Carefully designed layouts, contemporary interiors, spacious terraces, and functional spaces provide comfort and quality of daily life.
Amenities and benefits:
• Heated semi-Olympic pool
• Landscaped green areas and a botanical garden
• Children's playground and recreation area
• Contemporary architecture and elegant interior design
• Kitchen with built-in elements
• Air conditioners and Smart Home system
• Open parking
• Garage space at a price of 10.000 €
Some apartments on the ground floor have access to private green areas, while apartments on higher floors offer spacious terraces.
A peaceful environment, landscaped courtyard, and proximity to all important amenities make this complex an excellent choice for family life, vacation on the coast, or a long-term investment.
Planned completion of works: May 2027.

listing.title_text: The Peaks — Townhouses u Luštici br. 2662
listing.title_text_en: The Peaks — Townhouses in Luštica No. 2662
listing.description_text:
The Peaks - Townhouses
Najekskluzivnija kolekcija taunhausa u okviru luksuzne zajednice Luštica Bay. Smješteni na uzvišenju iznad Jadranskog mora i šampionksog golf terena Gary Player Design, taunhausovi The Peaks stvaraju novi format coastal golf living u Crnoj Gori – kombinaciju privatnosti vile, arhitekture na nivou resort residences i infrastrukture svjetske klase.
Dostupne opcije:
• Taunhausovi sa 3 spavaće sobe • Površina: 184–186 m² • Cijena: €2,524,000 – €2,643,000
Svi taunhausovi se nude u fazi izgradnje sa završetkom radova u decembru 2028. godine.
Svaki taunhaus je dizajniran po konceptu „život unutar i izvan kuće kao jedinstven prostor“ – dnevne zone se neprimjetno prelivaju u prostrane terase, privatne bašte, lounge zone i bazene. Rasporedi odvajaju javne i privatne prostore na dva nivoa, stvarajući osjećaj odvojene vile sa maksimalnim komforom i privatnošću. U mnogim rezidencijama predviđene su dnevne sobe sa dvostrukim svjetlom, kamini, master spavaće sobe sa izlazom na panoramske terase, tehničke prostorije i prostrane zone za odlaganje.
Karakteristike taunhausa:
• panoramski pogledi na more i golf teren • privatni bazeni • uređene bašte i ozelenjena unutrašnja dvorišta • ljetne kuhinje i otvorene dining zone • prostrane kamene terase • open-space dnevne sobe i dining zone • kamini u dnevnim sobama • panoramsko zastakljivanje • prirodni premium materijali • dizajnerske kuhinje Nolte ili sličnog premium nivoa • Miele uređaji • podno grijanje u kupatilima • sistemi klimatizacije sa zaštitom od vjetra • privatna parking mjesta • punjači za električna vozila • tehničke prostorije i zone za odlaganje • arhitektura u mediteranskom stilu • visoka privatnost rezidencija • lokacija pored golf clubhouse-a i wellness centra
Prvi stambeni golf kompleks u Crnoj Gori i jedini projekat ovog nivoa u regionu. Centralni dio područja biće prvo 18-rupno šampionkso golf teren u zemlji, razvijeno od strane legendarne kompanije Gary Player Design. Posebnost terena ogleda se u tome što se sa gotovo svake rupe pružaju panoramski pogledi na Jadransko more i Boku Kotorsku – što The Peaks čini dijelom rijetke kategorije golf zajednica sa morskim pogledima svjetskog nivoa.
Vlasnici taunhausa dobijaju potpuni pristup cjelokupnoj infrastrukturi Luštica Bay:
• privatne plaže i beach klubovi • marina sa šetalištem • 5-zvjezdani hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • restorani, kafići i butici • golf klub i golf akademija • trening teren za golf i golf simulator • spa centar i wellness infrastruktura • teniski i padel tereni • sportski tereni i otvorene fitnes zone • pješačke i biciklističke staze • 24-časovno obezbjeđenje i video nadzor • concierge servis i usluge upravljanja nekretninama
listing.description_text_en:
The Peaks - Townhouses
The most exclusive collection of townhouses within the luxury community of Luštica Bay. Perched on an elevation above the Adriatic Sea and the championship Gary Player Design golf course, The Peaks townhouses create a new format of coastal golf living in Montenegro — a blend of villa privacy, resort-level architecture, and world-class infrastructure.
Available options:
• 3-bedroom townhouses • Area: 184–186 m² • Price: €2,524,000 – €2,643,000
All townhouses are offered at the construction stage, with completion scheduled for December 2028.
Each townhouse is designed with the concept of "indoor and outdoor living as one space" — living areas flow seamlessly into spacious terraces, private gardens, lounge zones, and pools. The layouts separate public and private spaces across two levels, creating the feel of a standalone villa with maximum comfort and privacy. Many residences feature double-height living rooms, fireplaces, master bedrooms with access to panoramic terraces, utility rooms, and ample storage areas.
Townhouse features:
• panoramic views of the sea and golf course • private pools • landscaped gardens and green courtyards • summer kitchens and open dining areas • spacious stone terraces • open-plan living and dining areas • fireplaces in living rooms • panoramic glazing • natural premium materials • designer kitchens by Nolte or similar premium level • Miele appliances • heated floors in bathrooms • air conditioning systems with wind protection • private parking spaces • electric vehicle charging • utility rooms and storage areas • Mediterranean-style architecture • high privacy of residences • location near the golf clubhouse and wellness center
The first residential golf complex in Montenegro and the only project of this caliber in the region. The centerpiece of the area will be the country's first 18-hole championship golf course, designed by the legendary Gary Player Design. The course's unique feature is that nearly every hole offers panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea and the Bay of Kotor — making The Peaks part of a rare category of golf communities with world-class sea views.
Townhouse owners receive full access to all Luštica Bay infrastructure:
• private beaches and beach clubs • marina with a promenade • 5-star hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • restaurants, cafes, and boutiques • golf club and golf academy • practice golf course and golf simulator • spa center and wellness infrastructure • tennis and padel courts • sports fields and outdoor fitness areas • walking and cycling paths • 24/7 security and video surveillance • concierge service and property management services

The Peaks Apartments is a collection of premium residences in the most prestigious area of Luštica Bay, located next to Montenegro's first championship 18-hole golf course, designed by Gary Player Design. The project creates a new lifestyle format on the Adriatic, combining panoramic sea views, modern Mediterranean architecture, and world-class infrastructure.

The complex's architecture combines traditional Montenegrin materials — natural stone, wood, and light natural tones — with modern solutions and panoramic glazing. The spaces are designed according to the concept of unity between indoor and outdoor environments: living areas seamlessly transition into spacious terraces and relaxation zones with views of the sea and the golf course.
Apartment Features
• panoramic views of the sea and golf course • spacious terraces and relaxation areas • panoramic glazing • open-plan living and dining areas • natural premium materials • architecture by Block722 and NRA Atelier • designer premium-level kitchens • Miele appliances • heated floors in bathrooms • spacious master bedrooms • storage and utility rooms • underground parking • elevators and private access • high privacy of residences • landscaped grounds • shared pools and relaxation areas for complex residents.
The Peaks is the first residential golf complex in Montenegro and the only project of this caliber in the region. The centerpiece of the area will be the country's first 18-hole championship golf course, designed by Gary Player Design. A unique feature of the course is that almost every hole offers panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea and the Bay of Kotor.
Apartment owners receive full access to all Luštica Bay infrastructure:
• marina with a promenade • 5-star hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • restaurants, cafes, and boutiques • golf club and golf academy • practice golf range and golf simulator • spa center and wellness infrastructure • tennis and padel courts • sports fields and outdoor fitness areas • walking and cycling paths • 24/7 security and video surveillance • concierge service and property management services.

Vila je izgrađena po principu „prostor bez osećaja gustine“. Ovde ima mnogo vazduha, svetlosti i otvorenih zona koje se glatko povezuju. Na prvom nivou se nalazi veliki dnevni boravak sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom — jedinstven prostor za život, večere sa prijateljima i duge letnje večeri. Panoramski prozori pružaju izlaz na prostranu terasu, gde lako može da stane puna lounge-zona, trpezarijski sto i mesto za odmor pored mora.
Drugi nivo je u potpunosti posvećen privatnom delu kuće. Četiri odvojene spavaće sobe, nekoliko kupatila, master-blok sa sopstvenim kupatilom i garderobom. Raspored je napravljen tako da čak i pri punom smeštaju porodice ili gostiju kuća ne gubi osećaj privatnosti.
Donji nivo uključuje dodatne prostorije koje se mogu prilagoditi za kućnu teretanu, wellness-zonu, kućni bioskop, vinsku sobu ili odvojene gostinske prostore. Postoji privatna garaža i tehničke prostorije — retkost za Marina Village, gde je većina objekata predstavljena apartmanima.
Enterijeri su izvedeni u modernoj mediteranskoj estetici: prirodni kamen, tople teksture, mirna paleta, velikoformatno zastakljivanje. Kuća se ne oseća kao „odmarališna nekretnina“, već kao punopravna rezidencija za život pored mora.
O kraju Marina Village:
Marina Village je centralna šetališta Luštica Bay, izgrađena oko jahting marine, restorana i promenade za šetnju. Ovo je najživlji deo kompleksa, ali su vile smeštene tako da zadrže privatnost i osećaj zatvorenog kluba.
U pešačkoj dostupnosti se nalaze:
• jahting marina i šetalište • restorani i vinski barovi • butici i koncept-storovi • 5-zvezdani hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • plaže i bič klubovi • wellness- i fitness-infrastruktura • supermarketi i servisi za svakodnevni život
Vlasnici nekretnina dobijaju pristup celokupnoj infrastrukturi Luštica Bay:
• golf klub i golf akademija • golf simulator i trening zone • spa kompleks i wellness centar • teniski i padel tereni • koncijerž servis • usluge upravljanja nekretninama • 24-časovno obezbeđenje i video nadzor • pešačke i biciklističke staze duž obale
Lokacija:
• Aerodrom Tivat — oko 15 minuta automobilom • Kotor — oko 20 minuta • Budva — oko 35 minuta • Direktan pristup plažama i infrastrukturi Luštica Bay
Investicioni potencijal:
Vile ovakvog obima unutar Marina Village — izuzetno ograničen segment tržišta. Velika površina, format pune kuće, sopstvena garaža i lokacija pored marine čine objekat retkim čak i po merilima Luštica Bay. Ovakve rezidencije su tražene ne samo za lično stanovanje, već i među međunarodnim kupcima koji nekretninu posmatraju kao dugoročni aktiv na Jadranu.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale a 4-bedroom villa in Marina Village, Luštica Bay — one of the most exclusive and prestigious residences on the coast of Montenegro.
Key features:
• Total area: 416.5 m² • Terraces and outdoor spaces: 242.05 m² • Bedrooms: 4 • Bathrooms: 4+ • Type: villa • Floors: 3 levels • Garage: private garage
About the villa:
The villa is designed on the principle of "space without a sense of density." It features plenty of air, light, and open areas that seamlessly connect with each other. On the first level, there is a large living room with a kitchen and dining area — a unified space for living, dinners with friends, and long summer evenings. Panoramic windows open onto a spacious terrace, which can easily accommodate a full lounge area, dining table, and a relaxation spot by the sea.
The second level is entirely dedicated to the private part of the house. Four separate bedrooms, several bathrooms, and a master suite with its own bathroom and dressing room. The layout is designed so that even when the house is fully occupied by family or guests, it retains a sense of privacy.
The lower level includes additional rooms that can be adapted into a home gym, wellness area, home cinema, wine room, or separate guest spaces. There is a private garage and utility rooms — a rarity for Marina Village, where most properties are apartments.
The interiors are designed in a modern Mediterranean aesthetic: natural stone, warm textures, a calm palette, and large-format glazing. The house feels not like "resort real estate," but like a full-fledged residence for living by the sea.
About the Marina Village area:
Marina Village is the central promenade of Luštica Bay, built around a yacht marina, restaurants, and a walking promenade. It is the most vibrant part of the complex, yet the villas are positioned to maintain privacy and a sense of an exclusive club.
Within walking distance:
• Yacht marina and promenade • Restaurants and wine bars • Boutiques and concept stores • 5-star hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • Beaches and beach clubs • Wellness and fitness infrastructure • Supermarkets and everyday services
Property owners receive access to the entire Luštica Bay infrastructure:
• Golf club and golf academy • Golf simulator and training areas • Spa complex and wellness center • Tennis and padel courts • Concierge service • Property management services • 24/7 security and video surveillance • Pedestrian and cycling routes along the coast
Location:
• Tivat Airport — about 15 minutes by car • Kotor — about 20 minutes • Budva — about 35 minutes • Direct access to beaches and Luštica Bay infrastructure
Investment potential:
Villas of this scale within Marina Village represent an extremely limited market segment. The large area, full-house format, private garage, and location near the marina make this property rare even by Luštica Bay standards. Such residences are in demand not only for personal use but also among international buyers considering real estate as a long-term asset on the Adriatic.

listing.description_text:
Nudimo na prodaju apartman sa 1 spavaćom sobom u oblasti Centrale, Luštica Bay — novom gradskom centru jednog od najvećih i najpromišljenijih priobalnih projekata u Crnoj Gori. Stan je pogodan za one koji traže moderan smeštaj pored mora za život, odmor ili iznajmljivanje.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Ukupna površina: 61.25 m² • Terasa: 5.5 m² • Spavaća soba: 1 • Kupatilo: 1
O apartmanu:
Raspored je veoma udoban za svakodnevni život. Prostrana dnevna soba je povezana sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom, spavaća soba je odvojena od glavnog dela stana, a sam stambeni prostor deluje svetlo i otvoreno zahvaljujući velikim prozorima i promišljenom prostoru.
Enterijer je urađen u mirnom modernom stilu — svetlo drvo, prirodne nijanse, jednostavne linije. Ovaj stan ne deluje kao tipičan „odmarališni apartman“. Više kao potpuni gradski smeštaj pored mora, gde je zaista udobno živeti tokom cele godine.
O oblasti Centrale:
Centrale je budući centar svakodnevnog života unutar Luštica Bay. Oblast se razvija kao potpuna mediteranska četvrt sa trgovima, kafićima, prodavnicama i infrastrukturom za stalno stanovanje, a ne samo za letnji odmor. Ovde je manje turističke gužve nego kod marine, ali je cela infrastruktura kompleksa bukvalno u blizini.
U pešačkoj udaljenosti:
• centralni trg Piazza Centrale • kafići, restorani i pekare • supermarketi i prodavnice • sportski prostori • šetališta i zone za odmor • buduća međunarodna škola i medicinski centar • unutrašnji prevoz do Marina Village i plaža
Vlasnici nekretnina u Luštica Bay dobijaju pristup celokupnoj infrastrukturi projekta:
• plaže i beach klubovi • marina i šetalište Marina Village • hotel sa 5 zvezdica The Chedi Luštica Bay • teniski i padel tereni • wellness i spa infrastruktura • budući golf klub i golf teren The Peaks • koncijerž servis i upravljanje nekretninama • 24-časovno obezbeđenje kompleksa
Lokacija:
• Aerodrom Tivat — oko 15 minuta automobilom • Kotor — oko 20 minuta • Budva — oko 35 minuta • Plaže Luštica Bay — nekoliko minuta unutrašnjim šatlom ili automobilom
Investicioni potencijal:
Centrale se trenutno smatra jednom od najperspektivnijih oblasti unutar Luštica Bay. Oblast se aktivno razvija i postepeno postaje novi centar kompleksa, gde će biti koncentrisana glavna celogodišnja infrastruktura. Mali apartmani sa jednom spavaćom sobom su ovde posebno traženi za iznajmljivanje — kako leti, tako i van sezone, zahvaljujući potražnji od strane udaljenih radnika, porodica i rezidenata koji stalno žive u Luštica Bay.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale a 1-bedroom apartment in the Centrale district, Luštica Bay — the new urban center of one of the most extensive and thoughtfully designed coastal projects in Montenegro. The apartment is suitable for those seeking modern seaside living for residence, vacation, or rental.
Key features:
• Total area: 61.25 m² • Terrace: 5.5 m² • Bedrooms: 1 • Bathrooms: 1
About the apartment:
The layout here is very comfortable for daily living. A spacious living room is combined with the kitchen and dining area, the bedroom is separated from the main part of the apartment, and the living space itself feels bright and open thanks to large windows and thoughtful design.
The interior is done in a calm, modern style — light wood, natural shades, clean lines. This apartment does not feel like a typical "resort apartment." Rather, it feels like a full-fledged urban home by the sea, truly comfortable for year-round living.
About the Centrale district:
Centrale is the future center of everyday life within Luštica Bay. The area is being developed as a full Mediterranean quarter with squares, cafes, shops, and infrastructure for permanent residence, not just summer vacations. There is less tourist bustle here than near the marina, yet all the complex's amenities remain literally nearby.
Within walking distance:
• Piazza Centrale main square • Cafes, restaurants, and bakeries • Supermarkets and shops • Sports spaces • Promenade streets and relaxation areas • Future international school and medical center • Internal transport to Marina Village and beaches
Property owners in Luštica Bay receive access to the entire project infrastructure:
• Beaches and beach clubs • Marina and Marina Village promenade • 5-star hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • Tennis and padel courts • Wellness and spa facilities • Future golf club and golf course The Peaks • Concierge service and property management • 24-hour complex security
Location:
• Tivat Airport — about 15 minutes by car • Kotor — about 20 minutes • Budva — about 35 minutes • Luštica Bay beaches — a few minutes by internal shuttle or car
Investment potential:
Centrale is currently considered one of the most promising districts within Luštica Bay. The area is actively developing and gradually becoming the new center of the complex, where the main year-round infrastructure will be concentrated. Small one-bedroom apartments here are especially in demand for rental — both in summer and off-season, thanks to demand from remote workers, families, and residents who live in Luštica Bay permanently.

listing.title_text_en: Marina Village — Room in Luštica No. 2775
listing.description_text:
Nudimo na prodaju brendiranu rezidenciju u okviru hotela sa pet zvezdica The Chedi Luštica Bay — jedne od najprepoznatljivijih hotelskih adresa na crnogorskom primorju, smeštene u centru marine Luštica Bay.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Površina: 47 m² • Kategorija: Grand Deluxe soba sa pogledom na more • Spavaća soba: 1, predviđena za 2 odrasle osobe i dete • Balkon: sopstveni, sa pogledom na more i marinu • Očekivani godišnji prinos: 4–5%
O sobi:
Soba je uređena u svetloj, mirnoj paleti boja — terasa keramika na podu, detalji od hrastovine, panoramski prozori od poda do plafona i sopstveni balkon sa pogledom na more i jahte u marini. Soba poseduje mini-kuhinju, kadu i tuš sa kišnim efektom, Wi-Fi i kompletan set hotelskih pogodnosti.
O kompleksu:
The Chedi Luštica Bay — hotel sa pet zvezdica u centru marine Luštica Bay, na poluostrvu Luštica, u blizini Tivta. Na teritoriji se nalaze otvoreni i zatvoreni bazeni, spa centar, restorani, barovi, sopstvena plaža i razvijena infrastruktura marine sa jahtama, restoranima i prodavnicama.
Lokacija:
• Marina Luštica Bay — na teritoriji kompleksa • Svetionik i šetalište — na pešačkoj udaljenosti • Tivat — na nekoliko minuta vožnje
Investicioni potencijal:
Soba učestvuje u programu iznajmljivanja kojim upravlja hotel, što kupovinu pretvara u gotov aktiv koji ne zahteva samostalno upravljanje, sa očekivanim prinosom od 4–5% godišnje. Format brendirane rezidencije pri hotelu sa pet zvezdica u jednom od najtraženijih projekata na crnogorskom primorju kombinuje investicionu komponentu sa mogućnošću ličnog korišćenja sobe.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale a branded residence within the five-star The Chedi Luštica Bay hotel — one of the most recognizable hotel addresses on the Montenegrin coast, located in the heart of the Luštica Bay marina.
Key features:
• Area: 47 m² • Category: Grand Deluxe Room with a sea view • Bedroom: 1, designed for 2 adults and a child • Balcony: private, with a view of the sea and the marina • Expected annual yield: 4–5%
About the room:
The room is designed in a light, calm color palette — terrazzo ceramic flooring, oak details, floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows, and a private balcony with views of the sea and the yachts in the marina. The room features a kitchenette, a bathtub and a rain shower, Wi-Fi, and a full range of hotel amenities.
About the complex:
The Chedi Luštica Bay is a five-star hotel in the center of the Luštica Bay marina, on the Luštica peninsula, near Tivat. The premises include indoor and outdoor pools, a spa center, restaurants, bars, a private beach, and the developed infrastructure of the marina with yachts, restaurants, and shops.
Location:
• Luštica Bay Marina — on the territory of the complex • Lighthouse and promenade — within walking distance • Tivat — a few minutes' drive away
Investment potential:
The room participates in a hotel-managed rental program, which turns the purchase into a turnkey asset that requires no self-administration, with an expected yield of 4–5% per year. The branded residence format at a five-star hotel in one of the most sought-after projects on the Montenegrin coast combines an investment component with the possibility of personal use of the room.

Dizajnirane za nautički život, rezidencije u Porto Montenegru maksimalno koriste toplu, mediteransku klimu. Otvoreni, prozračni interijeri imaju visoke stropove, velike prozore i terase, dok arhitektura odražava historijski utjecaj Mletačke Republike.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 148
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2
Garage space
Luxury two-bedroom apartment in Ozana residence, Porto Montenegro.
The apartment consists of an entrance hall, bathroom, spacious open plan living room with dining area, kitchen, and two bedrooms with terraces, one of which is a master with its bathroom.
The apartment is bilaterally oriented, and has a view of the pool and partly the marina on one side and the promenade on the other.
The Ozana building has an extremely intimate and very beautiful swimming pool for apartment owners, a gym, a permanently available reception service, as well as shops and restaurants on the ground floor.
Designed for nautical life, the residences in Porto Montenegro make the most of the warm, Mediterranean climate. The open, airy interiors have high ceilings, large windows, and terraces, while the architecture reflects the historical influence of the Venetian Republic.

listing.title_text: Jedinstven penthaus Elena sa sedam spavaćih soba, Porto Montenegro
listing.description_text:
Stambena površina: 1003,26 m2 (475,09 m2 + 170,92 m2 terase + 357,25 m2 krovne terase)
Spavaće sobe: 7
Bathrooms: 7 + 2
Garage: 4
Storage units: 3
Swimming pools: 2
Ekskluzivan, jedinstven penthaus na „pola sprata“ u Elena Residences, Porto Montenegro, nastao spajanjem dva susjedna penthausa u jednu izuzetnu rezidenciju koju odlikuju veličina, privatnost i arhitektonska upečatljivost.
Riječ je o privatnoj rezidenciji ukupne površine 1003,26 m2 sa 7 spavaćih soba – rijetkoj ekskluzivnoj nekretnini u jednoj od najprestižnijih zgrada marine Porto Montenegro.
Rezidencija ima dva prostrana dnevna boravka sa trpezarijama i kuhinjama, sedam spavaćih soba sa sopstvenim kupatilima, toalete za goste i više velikih terasa sa spektakularnim pogledom na Bokokotorski zaliv, Lovćen, Tivat i marinu Porto Montenegro. Raspored omogućava fleksibilno korišćenje, uz punu funkcionalnu nezavisnost dva prvobitna penthausa.
Svaki penthaus zadržava sopstveni privatni ulaz sa posebnim liftom, što dodatno pojačava privatnost i ekskluzivnost. Na krovu su dvije privatne terase sa dva „infinity“ bazena samo za vlasnike, dvije potpuno opremljene spoljne kuhinje i dvije zone sa kaminom na drva – jedinstven prostor za život i druženje napolju.
Cijena uključuje ukupno četiri garažna mjesta i tri ostave, što rezidenciji dodaje udobnost i praktičnost.
Elena Residences je jedna od najtraženijih zgrada u Porto Montenegru, poznata po savremenoj arhitekturi, visokom standardu života i snažnom investicionom potencijalu. Porto Montenegro, kao marina svjetske klase, nudi luksuzan način života sa vrhunskim rezidencijama, hotelima, restoranima i buticima.
Ova nekretnina je zaista jedinstvena ponuda na tržištu – rijedak primjer privatne rezidencije na pola sprata ove veličine, sa 7 spavaćih soba i dvostrukim sadržajima na krovu. Vrijednost joj dodatno podižu panoramski pogled od 270 stepeni i lokacija u potpuno završenom dijelu master plana, bez buduće gradnje koja bi mogla uticati na pogled ili okruženje.
listing.description_text_en:
Residential area: 1003,26 m2 (475,09 m2 + 170,92 m2 terraces + 357,25 m2 roof terraces)
Bedrooms: 7
Bathrooms: 7 + 2
Garage: 4
Storage units: 3
Swimming pools: 2
An exclusive unique “half-floor” penthouse within Elena Residences, Porto Montenegro, created by merging two adjacent penthouse apartments into a single, exceptional residence defined by scale, privacy, and architectural presence.
The property represents a private residence with a total area of 1003,26 m2 featuring 7 bedrooms and positioned as a rare trophy asset within one of the most prestigious buildings in Porto Montenegro marina.
The residence comprises two expansive living rooms with dining areas and kitchens, seven en-suite bedrooms, guest toilets, and multiple large terraces that open to spectacular views of the Bay of Kotor, Mount Lovćen, Tivat, and the Porto Montenegro marina. The layout is designed to allow flexible use while maintaining full functional independence of the two original penthouses.
Each penthouse retains its own private entrance via dedicated elevator access, further enhancing privacy and exclusivity. On the rooftop, there are two private rooftop terraces featuring two “infinity” swimming pools exclusively for the owners, as well as two fully equipped outdoor kitchens and two wood-burning fireplace zones, creating a unique outdoor living and entertainment environment.
The price includes a total of four garage spaces and three storage units, adding further comfort and practicality to the residence.
Elena Residences is one of the most sought-after buildings within Porto Montenegro, recognized for its contemporary architecture, high-end standard of living, and strong investment potential. Porto Montenegro, as a world-class marina, offers a luxury lifestyle concept with premium residences, hotels, restaurants, and boutiques.
This property is positioned as a truly unique offering on the market, a rare example of a private half-floor residence of this scale, featuring 7 bedrooms and dual rooftop amenities. Its value is further enhanced by 270-degree panoramic views and its location within a fully completed part of the masterplan, with no future construction that could impact the views or surroundings.

listing.title_text: Stan Regent sa dvije spavaće sobe na obali
listing.description_text:
Površina: 178 m2
Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2+1
Dvosoban stan na samoj obali od 178 m2 u hotelu Regent 5*.
Stan je potpuno namješten po hotelskim standardima i sastoji se od prostranog dnevnog boravka sa trpezarijom i kuhinjom, dvije spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima, toaleta za goste i terase sa direktnim panoramskim pogledom na more.
Spektakularan objekat na samoj obali, hotel Regent je središte zajednice marine Porto Montenegro .
Posjedovati nekretninu u Porto Montenegru znači i postati dio međunarodne zajednice i uroniti u širok izbor kulturnih, sportskih i zabavnih aktivnosti koje pažljivo priprema uprava rizorta. Tu su i brojni sadržaji i aktivnosti za djecu, uključujući međunarodnu školu, jaht klub itd.
Porto Montenegro je svjetski marina resort sa ekskluzivnim rezidencijama, prodavnicama, hotelima i drugim sadržajima. Svaka zgrada ima recepciju 24/7, upravljanje objektom, obezbjeđenje, zajednički bazen, teretanu i slično.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 178 m2
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2+1
Waterfront, two-bedroom apartment of 178 m2 in Regent 5* hotel.
The apartment is fully furnished up to hotel standards and consists of a spacious living room with a dining area and kitchen, two en suite bedrooms, a guest toilet, and a terrace with a direct panoramic sea view.
Spectacular waterfront property, the Regent Hotel is a central piece within the Porto Montenegro marina community.
Owning a property in Porto Montenegro means also becoming a part of a multinational community and plunging into a wide range of cultural, sports, and entertainment activities which is carefully prepared for you by the resort management company. There are also plenty of amenities and activities for kids, including an international school, yacht club, etc..
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina resort with exclusive residences, retail, hotels, etc. Each building has 24/7 reception, facility management, security, a shared swimming pool, a gym, etc.

Površina: 620 m2 (320 m2 unutrašnje + terasa 300 m2)
Spavaće sobe: 4
Kupatila: 4 + 1
Jedinstven penthaus sa panoramskim pogledom u luksuznom stambenom kompleksu i marini za mega jahte Porto Montenegro. Stan je dio hotela Regent sa 5 zvjezdica, ukupne površine 620 m2 (320 m2 unutrašnje površine i terasa od 300 m2).
Ova elegantna nekretnina ima četiri spavaće sobe, 4 kupatila, toalet za goste, veliki dnevni boravak, odvojenu kuhinju i trpezariju, kao i veliku terasu okrenutu moru, koja okružuje stan sa svih strana, sa bazenom.
Stan se prodaje potpuno namješten, u skladu sa najvišim standardima hotela Regent. Savršeno je smješten na vrhu istočnog krila hotela, pa sa prostrane terase u potpunosti pruža spektakularan pogled na more i cijeli Tivatski zaliv. Penthaus ima i direktan pristup dvama bazenima, spa centru, teretani i vrhunskim restoranima hotela Regent.
Porto Montenegro je živa luksuzna marina za mega jahte na samoj obali, nekoliko minuta od centra Tivta, sa dugim šetalištem i lijepom obalom. Osim hotela Regent i vezova za plovila, Porto Montenegro nudi i nekoliko prepoznatljivih restorana, zanimljive kafiće, šoping zonu, prodavnicu, luksuzni bazen itd. – sve na nekoliko minuta hoda od stana.
Kompleks je povoljno smješten između dva glavna regionalna primorska aerodroma – samo 5 km od aerodroma Tivat i manje od 40 km od aerodroma Dubrovnik.
Kotor, sa Starim gradom pod zaštitom UNESCO-a, udaljen je 12 km.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 620 m2 (320 m2 internal + 300 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 4
Bathrooms: 4 + 1
A unique penthouse apartment, with panoramic views, within the Porto Montenegro luxury residential complex and mega yacht marina. The apartment is a part of the Regent 5 * hotel with a total area of 620m2, (320 m2 of internal area and 300 m2 terrace).
This elegant and stylish property comprises of four bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a guest toilet, a large living room, a separate kitchen and dining room, and a large terrace facing the sea, surrounding the apartment from all sides, with a swimming pool.
The apartment is sold entirely furnished, in accordance with the Regent Hotel’s highest standards. It is perfectly positioned, on top of the eastern wing of the Regent Hotel, thus maximizing all benefits from the spectacular views of the sea and the entire Bay of Tivat from its spacious terrace. Also, the penthouse features direct access to two pools, a SPA center, a gym, and Regent Hotel premium restaurants.
Porto Montenegro is a vibrant luxury marina for mega yachts, situated on the waterfront, just minutes away from the Tivat city center with a long promenade and beautiful coastline. Besides the Regent Hotel and the boat moorings, Porto Montenegro also offers several signature restaurants, interesting café-bars, a shopping village, a grocery store, a luxury swimming pool, etc… all within several minutes of walk away from the apartment.
The complex is conveniently located between two main regional coastal airports – it is only 5km from the airport in Tivat and less than 40km from Dubrovnik airport.
Kotor, with UNESCO-protected Old Town, is 12km away.

Boka Place is located on elevated ground overlooking the Porto Montenegro Marina, just a few minutes from the central waterfront resort and all its amenities.

listing.description_text:

Kupatila: 1
Studio od 43 m2 u zgradi Venezia, hotel Regent 5*
Sastoji se od dva dijela – velikog dnevnog boravka sa spavaćim dijelom i izlazom na terasu s pogledom na planine i šetalište, te ulaznog dijela s kuhinjom, hodnikom i prostranim kupatilom s kadom i tušem.
Stan je potpuno namješten i opremljen po hotelskim standardima.
Spektakularan objekat na obali, hotel Regent, centralni je dio marine Porto Montenegro.
Porto Montenegro je svjetski marina resort sa ekskluzivnim rezidencijama, prodavnicama, hotelima i drugim sadržajima. Svaka zgrada ima recepciju 24/7, upravljanje objektom, obezbjeđenje, zajednički bazen, teretanu i slično.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 43 m2
Bathrooms: 1
Studio apartment of 43 m2 in the Venezia building, Regent 5* hotel
It consists of two parts – a large living room with a sleeping area and access to the terrace with a view of the mountains and the promenade, and an entrance area with a kitchen, hallway, and a spacious bathroom with a bathtub and a shower.
The apartment is fully furnished and equipped according to hotel standards.
Spectacular waterfront property, the Regent Hotel is a central piece within the Porto Montenegro marina community.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina resort with exclusive residences, retail, hotels, etc. Each building has 24/7 reception, facility management, security, a shared swimming pool, a gym, etc.

Versa Residences je intimna kolekcija od 47 promišljeno osmišljenih stanova – studija, jednosobnih i dvosobnih – nastalih sa fokusom na ravnotežu, velnes i svakodnevnu udobnost. Bathrooms: 1
Garage

Kupatila: 1

Porto Montenegro je marina svjetske klase za superjahte, sa prekrasnom kolekcijom stambenih objekata, maloprodajnim objektima i velikim brojem restorana.
Najbliži aerodrom je Aerodrom Tivat, udaljen 4 km od Porto Montenegra. Aerodrom Dubrovnik udaljen je 48 km, a Aerodrom Podgorica 88 km.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 64 m2
Bedrooms: 1
Bathrooms: 1
A one-bedroom, furnished apartment in Tara building with sea view and direct access to a swimming pool.
The apartment occupies an area of 64 m2 and consists of a living room with a dining room and a kitchen, bedroom with bathroom, and a terrace with direct access to the swimming pool and a view of the sea.
Owners are offered concierge service and 24/7 security, as well as the use of outdoor swimming pool and gym.
Tara building is one of the most desirable ones within Porto Montenegro due to the beautiful interiors, spacious shared pool, greenery and style of construction.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina for super-yachts, with beautiful residential collection, retail, large number of restaurants.
The nearest airport is Tivat Airport, 4 km from Porto Montenegro. Dubrovnik Airport is 48 km away, Podgorica Airport is 88 km away.

Ekskluzivan, luksuzno namješten jednosoban stan u zgradi Teuta.
Stan se sastoji od prostranog otvorenog dnevnog boravka sa trpezarijom, kuhinje, prostrane terase sa otvorenim pogledom na more i marinu, spavaće sobe sa kupatilom i garderoberom, toaleta za goste i ostave.

Bedrooms: 1

Garage place
Exclusive, luxuriously furnished one-room apartment in the Teuta building.
The apartment consists of a spacious open-plan living room with a dining room, a kitchen, a spacious terrace with an open view of the sea and the marina, a bedroom with a bathroom and wardrobe, a guest toilet, and a storage room.
FEATURES

• 24-hour security and reception

listing.description_text:
Total area: 397 sqm
Internal area: 277 sqm
Ext. area: 120 sqm
Bedrooms: 4
Bathrooms: 4+toilet
Parking, furniture
Exclusive four-bedroom apartment of 397sq m, on the fourth floor of Teuta building, in Porto Montenegro super-yacht marina and residential complex.
The apartment has perfect position, with the main terrace of 120 sq m, opening directly towards the marina and overlooking the sea and the entire bay of Tivat.
FEATURES
• Sea and mountain view
• Fully furnished with modern interiors
• 24-hour security and reception
• Communal pool and gymnasium in the building
• Nearby all Village amenities (ATM, pharmacy, hair dresser, day spa, grocery shop)
Designed for nautical living, the residences at Porto Montenegro make the most of the warm, Mediterranean climate.
Open, airy interiors feature high ceilings, large windows and expansive terraces, while the architecture reflects the
historic influences of the Venetian Republic. Internationally acclaimed designer Tino Zervudachi has planned each residence in Porto Montenegro, individually sourcing materials both locally and from around the world.
Rooms are designed with a palette of soft colours, complemented by a mix of stone and hardwood. Lighting, sockets, switch plates and control panels are discreetly incorporated while integrated bookcases and
cupboards in natural timbers or soft paint complete the sense of refined luxury.

Spavaće sobe: 1

Cijena uključuje jedno garažno mjesto.
Boka Place je novi urbani kvart unutar Porto Montenegra, komercijalni i stambeni centar sa prodavnicama, kafićima, kinom, hotelom i wellness centrom, zelenim otvorenim prostorima, galerijama, svjetskim modnim brendovima i privatnim rezidencijama. Hotel SIRO (One& Only Group) će imati 144 upravljane rezidencije, 20-metarski krovni bazen, visoko-performansni studio, teretanu itd.
Boka Place se nalazi na uzvišenom terenu sa pogledom na marinu Porto Montenegro, svega nekoliko minuta od centralnog primorskog odmarališta i svih njegovih sadržaja.
listing.description_text_en:

Bedroom: 1
Bathroom: 1
Garage
One-bedroom apartment in the Thea building, part of the new mixed complex Boka Place in Porto Montenegro. The apartment has an area of 60 m2 and consists of an open-plan living room with a dining room and designed kitchen, a bedroom, a bathroom, a laundry room, and a terrace of 4 m2 with a partial sea view.
The price includes one garage space.
Boka Place is a new urban district within Porto Montenegro, a commercial and residential center with shops, cafes, a cinema, a hotel and wellness center, green open spaces, galleries, world fashion brands, and private residences. The residences are intelligently designed to offer both function and beauty.
Hotel SIRO (One& Only Group) will have 144 managed residences, a 20-meter rooftop swimming pool, a high-performance studio, a gym, etc.
Boka Place is located on elevated ground overlooking the Porto Montenegro Marina, just a few minutes from the central waterfront resort and all its amenities.

Kupatila: 2

Otvor iznad dnevnog boravka može se pretvoriti u treću spavaću sobu.
Cijena stana uključuje jedno garažno mjesto.
Boka Place je novi urbani kvart unutar Porto Montenegra, komercijalnog i stambenog centra s trgovinama, kafićima, kinom, hotelom i wellness centrom, zelenim vanjskim površinama, galerijama, svjetski poznatim modnim brendovima i privatnim rezidencijama. Bathrooms: 2

The opening above the living room can be converted into the third bedroom.
The price of the apartment includes one garage space.
Boka Place is the new urban quarter within Porto Montenegro, a commercial and residential center with shops, cafes, a cinema, a hotel and wellness hub, green outdoor areas, galleries, world-class fashion brands, and private residences. Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2+1
Furnished
Garage space
Well-proportioned two-bedroom apartment measuring 117 m2 with a sea view in Ksenija building.
It consists of an open-plan living room with a dining area and fully equipped kitchen, two en suite bedrooms, a guest toilet and a spacious terrace with a stunning sea view.
The apartment is for sale fully furnished and has one garage space included in the price.
The Ksenija building is one of the most desirable buildings in the Porto Montenegro complex, due to its style and quality of construction, with 2 beautiful swimming pools and views of the city promenade, the island of Sveti Marko, and the sea.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina and luxury resort, with exclusive residences, retail, hotels, etc. All buildings have a 24/7 reception, organized maintenance, facility management, security, shared swimming pools, gyms, etc.

Površina: 154 m2 (98 m2 + terase 56 m2)
Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2 + 1
Garaža
Prostrani dupleks penthaus od 154 m2 nalazi se u zgradi Alba, Boka Place, živoj urbanoj četvrti Porto Montenegra.
Na gornjem nivou su prostran otvoren dnevni boravak sa trpezarijom i kuhinjom, toalet za goste i izlaz na velike terase za boravak napolju i druženje.
Donji nivo je privatni spavaći dio, sa dvije udobne spavaće sobe, dva kupatila i direktnim izlazom na veliku terasu – idealan balans privatnosti i savremenog života.
Penthaus ima funkcionalan raspored, obilje prirodne svjetlosti i mnogo spoljnog prostora, pa je pogodan i kao glavni dom i kao luksuzna kuća za odmor.
Cijena stana uključuje jedno garažno mjesto.
Boka Place je najnovija višenamjenska četvrt Porto Montenegra, sa rezidencijama, prodavnicama, restoranima, kafićima, velnes sadržajima, zelenim javnim površinama i hotelom SIRO kompanije Kerzner International.
Na samo nekoliko minuta hoda od marine Porto Montenegro i šetališta uz more, Boka Place spaja moderan gradski život sa stilom života i sadržajima najprestižnije marine u Crnoj Gori.
