Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2 + 1
Garage space
The spacious duplex penthouse of 154 m2 is located in Alba building, Boka Place, Porto Montenegro’s vibrant urban quarter.
The upper level consists of a spacious open-plan living room with dining area and kitchen, a guest toilet, and access to expansive terraces designed for outdoor living and entertaining.
The lower level is dedicated to the private sleeping area and offers two comfortable bedrooms, two bathrooms, and direct access to the large terrace, creating an ideal balance between privacy and contemporary living.
The penthouse offers a functional layout, abundant natural light, and extensive outdoor space, making it suitable both as a primary residence and a luxury holiday home.
The price of the apartment includes one garage space.
Boka Place is Porto Montenegro’s newest mixed-use neighborhood, featuring residences, retail outlets, restaurants, cafés, wellness facilities, green public spaces, and the SIRO Hotel by Kerzner International.
Located just a short walk from Porto Montenegro Marina and the waterfront promenade, Boka Place combines modern urban living with the lifestyle and amenities of Montenegro’s most prestigious marina destination.

Apartman će imati opremljenu kuhinju, kao i ugradni ormar
Vlasnici će imati mogućnost da izaberu potpuno prilagođene pakete namještaja od Manor Interior Design, sa fiksnim cijenama do juna 2026.
Vero Residences obuhvata 155 modernih stanova, od studija do penthausa sa tri spavaće sobe, pažljivo dizajniranih da odgovaraju različitim stilovima života. Dizajniran sa fokusom na funkcionalnost i estetiku, Vero nudi mirni bazen na podijumu za opuštanje, četiri privatna ulaza radi optimalne praktičnosti i privatnosti, te elegantan centralni recepcijski prostor koji pruža udobnost i toplu dobrodošlicu — uz savremenu teretanu opremljenu vrhunskom fitnes opremom i sigurnu podzemnu garažu radi dodatne pogodnosti. Na prizemlju, pažljivo odabrani komercijalni prostori objedinjeni su sa buticima i vrhunskom gastronomijom, čime se dodatno unapređuje iskustvo života u zajednici.
Vero & Versa Residences se nalaze na pješačkoj udaljenosti od tržnog centra, međunarodne škole, medicinskog centra, raznih kafića i restorana sa internacionalnom kuhinjom, a udaljenost od mora je 50 m.
Pogodan plan plaćanja:
• Rezervacioni depozit: 10.000 €
• Predugovorni depozit: 10%, umanjen za rezervacioni depozit
• Prva rata: 30%, umanjena za predugovorni depozit
• Druga i treća rata, prema strukturi izgradnje: 25%
• Završna rata: 20% (kraj 2028. godine)
Cijena garažnog mjesta: 50.000 €
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 53 m2 (40 m2 + 7 m2 terrace + 6 m2 E.U.R.)
Bathrooms: 1
Garage
Studio apartment in Porto Montenegro brand new Vero residential building.
The apartment will consist of open space living and dining area with kitchen, one bathroom and a terrace.
Apartment will have an equipped kitchen as well as built-in wardrobe.

Vero Residences feature 155 modern homes, ranging from studio to three-bedroom penthouses, thoughtfully tailored to suit a wide range of lifestyles. On the ground floor, curated commercial spaces bring together boutique retail and upscale gastronomy, enhancing the community-focused living experience.
Vero & Versa Residences are located in walking distance to the shopping mall, international school, medical center, various cafes and restaurants with international cuisine and distance to the sea is 50 m.

listing.title_text: Apartman s 2 spavaće sobe na obali, Tara
listing.description_text:
Površina: 138 m2 (116 m2 + 22 m2 terasa)
Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2 + 1
Jedinstven dvosoban stan od 138 m2 na obali mora u zgradi Tara, s pogledom na Trg Venecije i marinu.
Dobro je proporcioniran i sadrži prostrani dnevni boravak otvorenog plana s kuhinjom i trpezarijom, dvije spavaće sobe s vlastitim kupatilima, gostinjski WC i veliku terasu natkrivenu pergolom od 22 m2 s pogledom na more. Stan se prodaje potpuno namješten.
Zgrada Tara je jedna od najtraženijih rezidencija u Porto Montenegru, zahvaljujući svom dizajnu, završnim obradama, povoljnoj lokaciji u centru naselja i prekrasno uređenim terasama i zajedničkim prostorima.
Stanarima su na raspolaganju zajednički bazen s pogledom na more, teretana, recepcija i osiguranje 24/7, usluge konsijerža i upravljanje nekretninama.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 138 m2 (116 m2 + 22 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2 + 1
Unique waterfront two-bedroom apartment of 138 m2 in Tara building, overlooking Venice Square and marina.
It is well-proportioned and contains a spacious open-plan living room with a kitchen and dining area, two en suite bedrooms, a guest toilet, and a large pergola-covered terrace of 22 m2 with a sea view. The apartment is for sale fully furnished.
Tara building is one of the most sought-after residencies in Porto Montenegro, due to its design, final finishings, convenient location in the center of the Village, and beautiful landscaped terraces and common areas.
The residents have at their disposal a communal swimming pool with a sea view, a gym, reception and security 24/7, concierge services, and property management.

listing.title_text: Stan sa dvije spavaće sobe na obali, Baia
listing.description_text:
Površina stana: 147 m2
Unutrašnja površina: 114 m2
Terasa: 33 m2
Spavaće sobe: 2
Kupatila: 2 + 1
Ekskluzivan stan u zgradi Baia, dijelu Regent Pool Club Residences. Stan ima dvije spavaće sobe, dva kupatila, toalet za goste, veliki dnevni boravak sa trpezarijom, kuhinju i veliku terasu sa otvorenim pogledom na marinu i more.
Zgrada Baia, druga završena zgrada u okviru Regent Pool Club Residences, jedan je od najnovijih djelova stambene ponude Porto Montenegra.
Ovi savremeni stanovi, svaki sa uređenim terasama, inspirisani su italijanskom rivijerom i imaju nesmetan pogled na more i planine.
Po modelu „hotelskog kondominijuma“, ove luksuzne rezidencije, uz mogućnost uključenja u program izdavanja, imaju direktan pristup uslugama i sadržajima hotela Regent sa pet zvjezdica i timu uprave na licu mjesta, koji na zahtjev vlasnika brine o održavanju i izdavanju.
listing.description_text_en:
Apartment area: 147 m2
Internal area: 114 m2
Terrace: 33 m2
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2 + 1
Exclusive apartment in Baia building, part of Regent Pool Club Residences. The apartment consists of two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a guest toilet, large living room with dining area, kitchen and a large terrace with open views of the marina and the sea.
Baia building, as the second finished building within Regent Pool Club Residences, is one of the newest parts of Porto Montenegro residential collection.
These contemporary apartments, each with landscaped terraces, are inspired by the Italian Riviera and have unobstructed sea and mountain views.
Based on the ‘hotel condominium’ model, these luxury residences for sale, with optional rental pool program, have direct access to the services and amenities of the five-star Regent Hotel and the onsite management team that can take care of all maintenance and rental administration at the owners’ request.

listing.title_text: Stan Baia sa tri spavaće sobe na obali
listing.description_text:
Površina stana: 220m2
Stambena površina: 146m2
Terasa: 74m2
Spavaćih soba: 3
Kupatila: 3 + toalet
Sprat: 3
Ekskluzivan stan na 3. spratu zgrade Baia, novog krila Regent Pool Club Residences. Ima tri spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima, veliki otvoren dnevni boravak sa trpezarijom, kuhinju i dvije velike terase – jednu sa otvorenim pogledom na bazen i more na istoku, drugu sa otvorenim pogledom na marinu i ulaz u Boku. Stan je potpuno namješten i spreman za useljenje.
Ovi savremeni, elegantni stanovi, svaki sa uređenim terasama, inspirisani su italijanskom rivijerom i imaju nesmetan pogled na more i planine – nesumnjivo vodeće nekretnine u Crnoj Gori.
Po modelu „hotelskog kondominijuma“, ove luksuzne rezidencije, uz mogućnost uključenja u program izdavanja, imaju direktan pristup brojnim uslugama i sadržajima hotela Regent sa pet zvjezdica i timu uprave na licu mjesta, koji na zahtjev vlasnika brine o održavanju i izdavanju.
Idealno za svakoga ko u Crnoj Gori želi da kupi po međunarodnim standardima
listing.description_text_en:
Apartment area: 220m2
Living area: 146m2
Terrace: 74m2
Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 3 + toilet
Floor: 3
Exclusive apartment on the 3rd floor of Baia building, the new wing of the Regent Pool Club Residences. The apartment has three ensuite bedrooms, large open space living room with dining area, kitchen and two large terraces, one of which has an open view of the pool and the sea from the east, and the other one also an open view of marina and the entrance of the Boka Bay. Apartment is fully furnished and ready for moving in.
These contemporary chic apartments, each with landscaped terraces, are inspired by the Italian Riviera and have unobstructed sea and mountain views offering undeniably the leading real estate in Montenegro.
Based on the ‘hotel condominium’ model, these luxury residences for sale, with optional rental pool program, have direct access to the extensive services and amenities of the five-star Regent Hotel and the onsite management team that can take care of all maintenance and rental administration at the owners’ request.
Ideal for anyone looking for international standards to buy in Montenegro

listing.title_text: Penthouse na rivi Tara, Porto Montenegro
listing.description_text:
Površina: 357 m2 (187 m2 + 170 m2 terase)
Spavaće sobe: 4
Kupatila: 3 + 1
Garaža
Penthouse od 357 m2 sa privatnim bazenom na krovnoj terasi i panoramskim pogledom na more i marinu, zgrada Tara.
Stan se sastoji od velikog dnevnog boravka otvorenog tipa s kaminom i izlazom na terasu s panoramskim pogledom na more, trpezarije, kuhinje, tri spavaće sobe, tri kupatila i velike radne sobe s izlazom na drugu terasu s bočnim pogledom na more.
Na krovu zgrade nalazi se privatna terasa s bazenom i prostorom za opuštanje s panoramskim pogledom na more.
Jedno garažno mjesto je uključeno u cijenu, dok je preuzimanje namještaja predmet posebnog dogovora.
Zgrada Tara se nalazi iza Trga Venecije, u blizini hotela Regent sa 5 zvjezdica.
Porto Montenegro je marina svjetske klase koja nudi ekskluzivne rezidencije, maloprodajne objekte i restorane.
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 357 m2 (187 m2 + 170 m2 terraces)
Bedrooms: 4
Bathrooms: 3 + 1
Garage space
Penthouse of 357 m2 with a private pool on the roof terrace and panoramic views of the sea and marina, Tara building.
The apartment consists of a large open-plan living room with a fireplace and access to a terrace with panoramic sea views, a dining room, a kitchen, three bedrooms, three bathrooms, and a large study with access to another terrace with side sea views.
On the roof of the building, there is a private terrace with a swimming pool and a relaxation area boasting a panoramic sea view.
One garage space is included in the price, while the furniture take-over is subject to a separate agreement.
The Tara building is situated behind Venice Square, near the Regent 5-star Hotel.
Porto Montenegro is a world-class marina that features exclusive residences, retail outlets, and restaurants.

listing.description_text:
Površina: 247 m2 (147 m2 + 100 m2 terasa)
Spavaćih soba: 3
Kupatila: 2+1
Garažna mjesta: 2
Trosobni penthaus površine 247 m2 sa direktnim pristupom bazenu na krovu u zgradi Zeta.
Apartman se sastoji od prostranog dnevnog boravka sa kuhinjom i izlazom na terasu pokrivenu pergolom i bazenom na krovu, tri spavaće sobe sa kupatilom, gostinskog WC-a sa vešerajem, te izlazom na još jednu terasu sa pogledom na more.
Cijena uključuje dva parking mjesta, sav ugradni i pokretni namještaj, bijelu tehniku i tehničku opremu.
KARAKTERISTIKE
Pogled na more i planine
24-satno obezbjeđenje i recepcija
Zajednički bazen i teretana u zgradi
Blizina svih sadržaja (bankomat, apoteka, frizerski salon, dnevni spa centar, trgovina)
listing.description_text_en:
Area: 247 m2 (147 m2 + 100 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 2+1
Garage spaces: 2
Three-bedroom penthouse of 247 m2 with direct access to the rooftop pool in the Zeta building.
The apartment consists of a spacious living room with a kitchen and access to a terrace covered by a pergola and a rooftop pool, three en suite bedrooms, a guest toilet with a laundry room, access to another terrace with a sea view.
The price includes two garage spaces and all built-in and movable furniture as well as white goods and technical equipment.
CHARACTERISTICS
Sea and mountain view
24-hour security and reception
Shared swimming pool and gym in the building
Close to all amenities (ATM, pharmacy, hair salon, day spa, store)
